Select exact IC50 activity rows for compounds tested against human hepatocyte growth factor receptor (CHEMBL3717). Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to enforce presence of canonical_smiles. Join compound_records and docs to retrieve compound_key and pubmed_id_or_doi, enforcing presence of pubmed_id or DOI. Return columns compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Do not deduplicate rows.
